items.title: $7 billion and counting: Why now is the time to build on Atlassian
items.summary: Partners helped build a $7 billion Marketplace. What will you build next? The Atlassian Marketplace has surpassed $7B in lifetime sales, and while that alone is a milestone worth celebrating, the pace behind it may be even more exciting.
